name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on the bench and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar to mid-chest, then press it back up to full extension.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Rest the bar across your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Descend until thighs are at least parallel, then drive up through your heels.

name: Conventional Deadlift
instructions: Stand with mid-foot under the bar and grip just outside your knees.
Drive through the floor and stand tall, keeping the bar close to your body.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your chin over the bar, then lower under control.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor, then press back up.

name: Standing Overhead Press
instructions: Hold the bar at shoulder height with a shoulder-width grip.
Press overhead to full lockout, then lower to the shoulders.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, holding the bar at arm's length.
Row the bar to your lower ribs, then lower under control.

name: Plank
instructions: Rest on your forearms and toes with a straight body line.
Brace your core and hold.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms forward.
Curl to the shoulders, then lower slowly.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward into a lunge until both knees are ~90 degrees.
Push off the front foot and step through into the next lunge.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand tall on the balls of your feet.
Raise your heels as high as possible, then lower slowly.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Jump while spreading your legs and raising your arms overhead.
Return to standing and repeat rhythmically.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips, reaching toward your toes.
Hold at a gentle stretch without bouncing.
